english.title: Knowingly / recklessly make false statement in response to an information notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[made a statement which you knew to be false]_
(B)_[recklessly made a statement that was false]_

in a material respect, in response to an information notice issued in accordance with section 142 of the Data Protection Act 2018, namely **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 144 and 196(2) of the Data Protection Act 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
made a statement known to be false in a material respect OR
recklessly made a statement that was false in a material respect
in response to an information notice
issued in accordance with section 142 of the Data Protection Act 2018

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Prosecution only by the Commissioner or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.
(ii) Where this offence has been committed by a body corporate, and it is proved to have been committed with the consent or connivance of or to be attributable to neglect on the part of a director, manager, secretary or similar officer of the body corporate, or a person who was purporting to act in such a capacity, the director, manager, secretary, as well as the body corporate is guilty of the offence and proceedings can also be taken against them.
(iii) Section 199(1) of the Data Protection Act 2018 states that the National Police Records (Recordable Offences) Regulations 2000 (S.I. 2000/1139) has effect as if this offence was listed in the Schedule to the Regulations. Therefore offenders must be fingerprinted and photographed as well as the offence being PNC recordable.

other.penalty:
